assessments.reasoning: The ordinary name-resolution section explicitly excludes type-parameter rebinding by nonlocal. The annotation-scope section repeats the exclusion for an inner scope and identifies type parameters as the relevant names. These passages support the exact qualified prohibition.

challenge.method: Read both restrictions and challenged the condition by compiling an inner nonlocal binding of a generic type parameter, reading that parameter without a declaration and rebinding a same-spelled ordinary function local in a separate fixture.
challenge.results: The type-parameter binding directive raised the specific SyntaxError. The read-only example and the ordinary function binding both succeeded. Their results preserve the distinction between a type parameter and a merely same-spelled name.

limitations: The scope concerns a nonlocal directive targeting an actual enclosing annotation-scope type parameter. A read of that parameter and a separate ordinary local are outside the prohibition.
